ambient_events: Wash off the basin slaps the fenders and runs back down the face of the quay.
A strop swings against the skip, rings once, and stops.
Grit blows across the slab in a long thin line and piles against the kerb.
description: The landward end of the quay, where the slab widens out enough to turn a rig on. Chain and strop coiled against the kerb, a skip of scrap nobody has come for, and an old walkway line worn down to the aggregate. The two cranes stand over the water to the NORTH.
name: Basin Quay
